rv.q: By the show's end, one feels not merely entertained, but converted—a joyful initiate in Goodman's glittering gospel of self-love.
Goodman, it turns out, is a genuinely magnetic priest, and their enthusiasm and vulnerability make their ennobling message worth hearing yet again.
Heaux Church may not be for the faint of heart, but its message of radical self-acceptance lands with surprising grace.

cn.t: Brandon Kyle Goodman's joyful solo show transforms sex education into a liberating gospel of pleasure and self-acceptance, with critics praising its ecstatic energy and mission to redefine shame into pride.
